description_en: Bind disks into a enterprise-level snapshot policy
description_zh: 调用BindEnterpriseSnapshotPolicy绑定云盘到企业级快照策略
kebab_example: aliyun ebs bind-enterprise-snapshot-policy --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --policy-id esp-xxx --region cn-hangzhou
name: BindEnterpriseSnapshotPolicy

parameters.help_en: The region ID . You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/354276.html operation to query the most recent list of regions in which snapshot policy is supported
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the value, but you must ensure that it is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.name: client_token
